model.label: Model
model.notDownloadedHint: Run scripts/download_models.py before enhancing with this model.
model.loadFailedDetail: The backend did not return the available models. Check that it is running.

scale.label: Upscale factor
scale.descriptionTwoPass: Every factor is produced by neural passes. 8x runs two: 4x then 2x.
scale.descriptionLimited: Factors this model cannot produce are unavailable.

denoise.label: Noise reduction
denoise.description: Interpolates the model weights. 100% is the model as shipped, which denoises the most; lowering it blends toward weights that keep more grain.
denoise.unavailable: {{model}} has no denoise weights to blend.
denoise.unavailableGeneric: This model has no denoise weights to blend.

sharpen.label: Sharpening
sharpen.description: An unsharp mask applied after upscaling. A post-process, not a model feature.

artifacts.label: Artifact reduction
artifacts.description: Needs a dedicated JPEG restoration model. A blur filter here would smear detail while claiming to add it.

quality.label: Quality
quality.descriptionLossy: Higher keeps more detail and makes a larger file.
quality.descriptionLossless: PNG is lossless, so there is no quality to trade.

metadata.label: Preserve metadata
metadata.description: Keep EXIF and the ICC colour profile. Turning this off drops location and camera tags.
